title: From a prion seed to a tree of discoveries: Byron Caughey’s RT-QuIC legacy in protein misfolding research
title_zh: 从种子到树木：拜伦·考希在蛋白质错构象研究中的RT-QuIC遗产
abstract: Early and accurate detection of prions is essential for effective disease management and potential therapeutic intervention. Similar challenges extend across other protein misfolding diseases, which require ultrasensitive methods for detection, discrimination, and quantification of "prion-like" pathological proteins. Over a scientific career spanning multiple decades, Dr. Byron Caughey investigated mechanisms of prion conversion and replication, pioneered cell-free prion conversion assays, and steadfastly pursued increasingly sensitive, specific, robust, and high-throughput methods for prion amplification. His breakthrough development and continued refinement of the Real-Time Quaking-Induced Conversion (RT-QuIC) assay revolutionized prion research and helped extend seed amplification technology across the broader field of protein misfolding diseases. These assays have been developed through seminal contributions by many eminent scientists, and the breadth of this rapidly expanding field extends well beyond the scope of this review. Accordingly, we focus here on honoring Dr. Byron Caughey's legacy by highlighting his foundational contributions to in vitro amplification and ultrasensitive detection of disease-associated protein aggregates. We further highlight the visionary, multidisciplinary, and collaborative nature of his work including the expansion of the platform to strain discrimination, surveillance, misfolded protein quantification, therapeutic research, higher throughput assay formats and the detection of other disease-associated misfolded proteins, including α-synuclein, tau, SOD1, and more.
abstract_zh: 早期和准确的检测对于有效的疾病管理和潜在的治疗干预至关重要。这些挑战延伸至其他蛋白质错构象疾病，后者需要超灵敏的检测、鉴别和定量方法来检测“朊样”病理蛋白。在数十年的科研生涯中，拜伦·考希研究了朊转化和复制的机制，开创了细胞自由朊转化试验，并不断追求更敏感、更特异、更健壮和更高通量的朊增幅方法。他对实时诱导转换（RT-QuIC）试验的突破性开发及其不断完善，彻底改变了朊类研究，并帮助将种子放大技术扩展至更广泛的蛋白质错构象疾病领域。这些试验经由众多杰出科学家的开创性贡献而开发，该领域的广度远超本综述的范围。因此，我们的重点在于通过突出他在体内扩增和疾病相关蛋白聚集的超灵敏检测方面的基础性贡献，来荣誉拜伦·考希的遗产。我们进一步阐述了他工作中具有远见、跨学科和协作性质的特点，包括该平台在菌株鉴别、监测、错构象蛋白定量、治疗研究、更高通量试验格式以及其他疾病相关错构象蛋白（包括α-突触核蛋白、tau、SOD1等）检测方面的扩展。
